rules.statement: The acceptance of a donation by the major brother on behalf of his minor siblings is valid if the donor has allowed such acceptance.
rules.supporting_quote: However, it is now clear from Abeyewardene v. West that in the case of a donation made by parents, acceptance of the donation by the brother-in-law and the brothers of the minor donee is good, for the reason that the donors have allowed such acceptance to be made on behalf of the minor child.

meta.parties: Kirigoris K V v. Eddinhamy S.J.A
